name: 2ECONDS TO STΔRLIVHT: Forever My Diamond
source:
As graduation looms, true feelings begin to surface. Will Grace find the courage to overcome her shyness and bare her heart to Sera, or will her handsome rival Akira get to her first?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1329110/]Steam[/url]]

This visual novel is a prequel to the rhythm game [url=https://anarch.games/starlivht/]NOISZ STΔRLIVHT[/url].
translation:
随着毕业的临近，真实的感情开始浮出水面。格蕾丝会找到勇气克服害羞并向世拉敞开心扉，还是她英俊的对手阿基拉会先找到她？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1329110/]Steam[/url]]

这部视觉小说是节奏游戏的前传 [url=https://anarch.games/starlivht/]NOISZ STΔRLIVHT[/url]。
